"Alien" special shape - final concept

envelope - the master patterns, full-size master patterns (no scaling) - 2,610 m3 / 92,171 cu ft, 20 gores, 17 panel rows to the envelope opening (Nomex + A-P), per the envelope layout diagram.

front (face = gore 1)
rear - turning vents, seams 15/16 & 16/17
antenna detail (x1.25 scale)

Hull

Factory profile from the the master patterns (flatter top, straight sides in the bottom third, constant drop angle to the mouth) - full-size master patterns (no scaling). Height 18,338 mm (~20,620 mm over the basket); width 17,887 mm; volume 2,610 m3 / 92,171 cu ft. Mouth O 3,988 mm. Bright green ripstop; NOMEX bottom row and scoop in black.

Eyes

Two black teardrop ram-air pods, gores 18-20 (left) / 2-4 (right), rows F-J exactly; footprint 7.96 x 6.81 m, standing ~1.3 m proud via a 115 % lens. Fed by three O450/O500 holes per pod (panels G/H/i).

Mouth

Bold black crescent applique, 5.09 m wide x 1.19 m tall, row C across gores 20/1/2, sewn flat before gore assembly.

Antennae

Two x 3.75 m (2.25 m black tapered cone, O 0.875 m to O 0.31 m + O 1.5 m red ball, #e9132f), bases mid row N on gores 18 & 4, leaning 35 deg outboard; ram-air pressurized, self-supporting, 350 mm equator zips for deflation.

Turning vents

Overlap (MOUSE) construction at seams 15/16 & 16/17 flanking gore 16 - the left side as you face the balloon (face up), 90 deg off the face centerline. Two rows tall (i-J); self-sealing 70 mm lips; invisible from the front.

Parachute

O 5,000 mm hole, 360 mm radial seal overlap; confluence 3,600 mm; centering 3,598-3,639 mm.
